jobs.title: Software Engineer, Quality (Web)
jobs.description:
At Unity, our QA team members are the test and quality experts for feature areas. We are fully embedded and rely on communication and collaboration to help the whole team deliver quality software. We are responsible for fostering a culture of quality and facilitating the idea of challenging quality issues across the entire team.

You'll be embedded and working closely with developers for the Web Platform team. In addition to working as part of your development team, you will be part of a global Platform QA team that actively works to ensure the functionality, stability, and usability across all of Unity’s platforms.

In this role, you will engage with QA, producers, and development on test strategies and approaches for a variety of projects. You will help the team find the right balance of automated and manual testing, and contribute to the tools and processes that continually improve quality across the team. We expect you to be hands-on and empowered to dive in and solve technical testing challenges as needed.

We believe testing is a craft that requires training and skill. We invest in our employees and expect you to invest in your own professional growth. Our employees love to learn, and challenge themselves as well as each other to grow.

What You’ll Be Doing

Independently develop and maintain the test approach for your designated areas, balancing manual and automated coverage with your developers
Prioritise and adjust your testing as the work evolves, directing effort where it has the most effect
Review pull requests and technical designs to identify coverage gaps and surface risks early
Identify the quality information your team needs to make decisions and report on it regularly
Plan and estimate your own work, committing to what you can deliver and renegotiating scope when capacity is exceeded
Contribute to quality improvements in your team and help see them through to adoption
Coach developers on testing practice and give feedback they can act on
Build working relationships across development, product and other partner functions, taking the initiative in bringing QA into their work early

What We’re Looking For

Solid grounding in QA principles and methodologies, and the judgement to apply them without close supervision
Programming experience with C#, strong enough to review developers’ code changes and maintain automated tests
Experience deriving a test approach for complex functionality from requirements and technical design
Experience raising quality standards within a team, including coaching engineers who don’t report to you
Able to justify your estimates and hold to them when priorities shift
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the early escalation of risk

You might also have

Experience with testing WebAssembly applications in browser environments
Working knowledge of the Unity Editor and building Unity projects
Programming experience with JavaScript
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and maintaining automated test suites within them
Scrum certification or experience working in a Scrum team

Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location:

Zone A: €41,800 - €52,200 EUR gross

This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.

Benefits

At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well-being and work-life balance.

Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status.

While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance | Commute subsidy | Employee stock ownership | Competitive retirement/pension plans | Generous vacation and personal days | Support for new parents through leave and family-care programs | Office food snacks | Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support | Employee Resource Groups | Global Employee Assistance Program | Training and development programs | Volunteering and donation matching program

Life at Unity

Unity [NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com.
